name: JUSE
description: Juse is a unique and high-intensity 'competitive patience' game from Sri Lanka. Unlike traditional solitaire, several players compete in real-time to build piles in the center and on each other's discard piles. It is a game of rapid pattern recognition where failure to play a 'forced' card results in a penalty (Juse!), making it a chaotic and energetic social experience.

content.text: Juse is a unique and high-intensity 'competitive patience' game from Sri Lanka. Unlike traditional solitaire, several players compete in real-time to build piles in the center and on each other's discard piles. It is a game of rapid pattern recognition where failure to play a 'forced' card results in a penalty (Juse!), making it a chaotic and energetic social experience.

Developed in Sri Lanka as a local adaptation of games like 'Crapette' or 'Racing Demon'. The name 'Juse' (possibly a variant of the name 'Joseph' or a local exclamation) refers to the act of calling out a player's mistake.
Any number, but odd numbers (3, 5, 7) are traditional.
Deal cards face-down equally until 1 card remains. That last card is placed in the center to start the first foundation pile.
